annotations.title: Coverage registry: which venues and data types we collect, how, and how fresh

description: Call this when the user asks which exchanges sit behind a ByKaranteli number, whether a feed is complete or sampled, since when a venue is collected, or how fresh the data is. Returns the live coverage registry: liquidation feeds per venue with kind and last record, snapshot feeds per venue and market, funding arbitrage legs, positioning sources, whale tape, spot minutes and the Hyperliquid whale scan with freshness. snapshots[].country is the jurisdiction only when the venue states one; it is null for most venues, so do not read null as unknown risk. By default the first 30 snapshot feeds, English notes only and no per-venue matrix cells; pass detail "full" for the full registry. Pass detail "compact" for a shorter page or "full" for the whole answer.

detail.description: Optional. "compact": a shorter page than the default (fewer rows, newest points kept, rounded figures, long text cut, grids left out; every cut named in trimmed). "full" or true: the whole route answer, still under the 100,000 character ceiling (the largest boards answer the ceiling note then: narrow them with symbol, limit or days instead). Omitted or false: the default first page.
